general.name: Disk Space - Free Space Below Threshold [Lin]
general.description:
Alerts when a filesystem is at or above a percent-used threshold (optionally also under a free-GB floor); also catches btrfs metadata and LVM thin pool exhaustion. Read-only.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Monitors/disk-space-free-space-below-threshold-lin

variables.name: usrThreshold
variables.description: 1-99. Percent used that counts as full; alerts at or above it.

variables.name: usrMinFreeGB
variables.description: Whole GB. Also require free space below this to alert. 0 = percent only.

variables.name: usrDisks
variables.description: ALL, or a space-separated list of mount points or devices. Globs allowed.

variables.name: usrExclude
variables.description: Space-separated glob patterns (mount points or devices) to skip when usrDisks is ALL.

variables.name: usrUnknownFs
variables.description: Network or unrecognised filesystems: Warn = name them in the status, Alert = alert, Ignore = hide them.

variables.name: usrPoolThreshold
variables.description: 1-99. Percent for btrfs metadata and LVM thin pool data and metadata.
